name: PersistentClusterCull
scope: Original Xbox compute programs and embedded root signatures at device slot 62. Every case reads all six UAVs. Fixtures check queue reservations, resident children, streaming requests, projection clipping, LOD rejection, hardware and software lists, previous-pass offsets and visible-list capacity. All variants read an indexed 16-byte hierarchy lookup, and the two multiview variants select the second 800-byte view. The HZB checks cover previous transforms, mixed visibility and post-pass cluster reservations across a 64-record batch boundary. Each visible or occluded record contains the slot followed by the two packed words.
